abilities.name: Titan's Grip
per_rank_text:
Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand. 

Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.

Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
per_rank_text: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. In addition, the duration of all harmful Magic effects used against you is reduced by 30%. @ext:Only one type of Mage Armor spell can be active at any time.:ext@

abilities.name: Blink

abilities.name: Focus Magic
Vampiric Touch
per_rank_text:
Causes 340 Shadow damage over 15 sec to your target. 

When you deal damage with Mind Blast to a target afflicted by your Vampiric Touch, you gain |cFFFFFFFFReplenishment|r.

If Vampiric Touch is dispelled it will cause 544 damage to the afflicted target.

@s:57669:0@

per_rank_text: Causes an explosion of shadow magic around the enemy target, causing 50 to 57 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to all enemies within 10 yards around the target.

abilities.name: Dispel Magic
per_rank_text: Dispels magic on the target, removing 1 harmful spells from a friend or 1 beneficial spells from an enemy.

abilities.name: Vampiric Embrace

abilities.name: Mind Blast
per_rank_text: Blasts the target for 39 to 43 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Mind Flay
per_rank_text: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 45 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

abilities.name: Shadowform
per_rank_text:
Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15%$?s102217[ and reduces all damage taken by 0%][].

You may not cast Healing or Priest Holy spells while in this form except for Cure Disease and Abolish Disease.

Grants the periodic damage from your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch spells the ability to critically hit and benefit from haste.

per_rank_text: You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%. You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every 1 sec for 6 sec. Dispersion can be cast while stunned, feared or silenced and clears all snare and movement impairing effects when cast.

abilities.name: Life Tap
per_rank_text: Converts 15 health into mana. Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

abilities.name: Create Spellstone
per_rank_text:
While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by periodic spells by 2% and spell haste rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.
